scope: Flag- and GFP-NUPR1 coimmunoprecipitations and LC-MS/MS analysis
Equal amounts of total protein were used to incubate with 30 μL of anti-Flag M2-coated beads (MilliporeSigma, F3165) or GFP-Trap Agarose (Chromotek, GTA-10).
Beads were then washed 3 times, and proteins were eluted using ammonium hydrogen carbonate buffer containing 0.1 μg/μL of Flag peptide (MilliporeSigma, F3290).

Lysates from MiaPaCa-2 cells (transfected with NUPR1-Flag or NUPR1-GFP) were used for immunoprecipitation, performed with agarose beads coated with anti-Flag or anti-GFP antibodies. After immunoprecipitation, the eluted proteins were analyzed by LC-MS/MS.
